guard: cotal sync reports each signed-in account's refresh on the envelope, names a failed account in a warning with the result partial, takes --idp as its target, and refuses when no account could be refreshed
why: Each mutation removes one way a failed refresh reaches the result, or the --idp target. The suite imports the sync command from source, so no rebuild is needed.

mutations.name: a failed account does not make the result partial
mutations.expectRed: sync --json reports every account, and a failed one makes it partial, exit 4
mutations.cell: sync --json reports every account, and a failed one makes it partial, exit 4

mutations.name: a failed account is not named in a warning
mutations.expectRed: the failed account is named in a CATALOG_UNAVAILABLE warning and keeps its error
mutations.cell: the failed account is named in a CATALOG_UNAVAILABLE warning and keeps its error

mutations.name: no refreshed account is not refused
mutations.expectRed: sync with no account refreshed is refused DEPENDENCY_UNAVAILABLE
mutations.cell: sync with no account refreshed is refused DEPENDENCY_UNAVAILABLE

mutations.name: --idp is not the target
mutations.find: target: values.idp === undefined ? null : { idp: values.idp },
mutations.expectRed: sync --idp refreshes that account alone: ok, exit 0, its IdP the target
mutations.cell: sync --idp refreshes that account alone: ok, exit 0, its IdP the target

mutations.name: a failed account loses its error
mutations.expectRed: sync --json reports every account, and a failed one makes it partial, exit 4
mutations.cell: sync --json reports every account, and a failed one makes it partial, exit 4
